stories.title: SEC clears hurdle as crypto token buybacks hit record $638 million

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs turn positive for 2026 after $2.4 billion weekly inflow
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in $2.4 billion over the past week. That is their largest weekly inflow since October. The inflow pushed year-to-date flows into positive territory for 2026.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows are a direct read on institutional demand for bitcoin, and this reverses a weak run for the year.
whatToWatch: Whether inflows continue next week
Flow breakdowns by individual fund
questions: What drove the sudden shift in demand?

stories.title: Fed's proposed stablecoin rule could trigger a 48-hour liquidation run
stories.summary: The Federal Reserve proposed a rule that would make stablecoin circulation a capital cost for supervised issuers. Analysts warn the rule could trigger a 48-hour liquidation run if issuers rush to adjust. The proposal targets banks and other supervised entities that issue stablecoins.
stories.whyItMatters: A capital charge on stablecoin issuance could reshape which banks are willing to issue stablecoins, and the warned liquidation risk touches the whole stablecoin market.
whatToWatch: The proposal's comment period and final rule text
Issuer statements on compliance plans
questions: Which issuers count as 'supervised' under the rule?
How likely is the warned liquidation scenario?
